thread:
elaine: Heads-up everyone: we're publishing a formal sunset plan for the legacy SDK 'compat_layer' toggle. Goal: remove the extra runtime path so we can ship newer attention optimizations and reduce maintenance overhead. High-level schedule and migration aids below.

docs-bot: Migration guide published: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/migrate-compat. Includes codemod, linter rule, and quick checklist.

kevin: short Q: will existing customers break on June 15 or just a banner?

elaine: June 15 is the soft notice + Console banner and email. The flag will still work during the opt-in grace. Enforcement windows step in later (details below).

elaine: Full timeline:
- June 15 1 opt-in grace and banner + docs/email.
- July 15 1 new orgs fail-fast if they try to enable compat_layer.
- August 1 1 begin canary group: 5% of traffic will run without compat_layer to validate.
- Aug 30 1 gradual runtime enforcement for Hosted API.
- Sept 15 1 Hosted API: compat_layer disabled for everyone. Dedicated/Private on separate cadence (AMs will coordinate).

maya: For big customers we should offer a migration SLA and a holdback for Dedicated/private.

elaine: Correct. AMs can request a customized window. Docs guide has a "Private/Dedicated migration checklist" and a template SLA addendum.

jonah: What's included in the codemod? Any false-positive risk?

docs-bot: Codemod command: `rw-sdk-migrate --replace compat_layer:modern_api`. It updates usage patterns and example config, plus optional dry-run mode. We added unit tests and a preview diff output. False positives are rare but teams should run `rw-sdk-check --dry-run` first.

sam: Support plan: I'll reserve 3 SEs for migration triage and 2 runtime engineers for the canary window. Office hours start June 18, weekly.

kevin: How will we monitor regressions?

elaine: We'll collect per-route p50/p95 latency, token-level error rate, and run prompt-diff checks on our 50 canonical prompts. Alert if quality delta >= 3% or latency p50 regresses > 20ms. Canary dashboard will surface these metrics.

maya: Can marketing draft a customer FAQ and a template announcement?

elaine: Yes, marketing + product to own the customer FAQ. Draft due June 3 so we can review before June 15 send.

jonah: Rollback path if a regression shows up mid-canary?

elaine: Rollback options: 1) route affected orgs to `model_variant=v1-compat` via routing rule; 2) flip serving feature flag to re-enable compat path for canary cohort. We'll publish the rollback runbook in the guide.

support-bot: Added #support-sdk-migrations channel and calendar invites for office hours.

kevin: Any changes required for Dedicated/private deployments?

elaine: Yes 1 Dedicated/private won't be force-changed on Sept 15 without AM coordination. We'll offer a migration bundle (codemod + 2 SEs + one runtime engineer for a paid migration window).

maya: Suggestion: add an automated CI check in the SDK sample repos to flag compat_layer usage during PRs.

docs-bot: Done: `rw-sdk-check` linter rule added to sample repo templates. Also added GH actions example in the migration docs.

elaine: Action items:
- Docs: finalize migration guide and rollback runbook (owner: docs, due: June 5).
- Eng: enable canary infra and create canary dashboard (owner: runtime team, due: July 10).
- Support: staff office hours and create support channel (owner: support, done).
- Marketing/Product: publish FAQ + customer email copy (due: June 3).
- AMs: start outreach to top 20 customers for Dedicated/private windows (owner: sales/AMs).

jonah: I'll add tickets in `infra/canaries` and tag runtime on-call.

sam: I'll share the office hours calendar link in #company-announcements after marketing approves the copy.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll send the customer email and enable the Console banner on June 15. If you maintain any repos that might still use `compat_layer`, run `rw-sdk-check` now and file `sdk-compat-migration` tickets.
